title: [Box Damaged] Dyson V8 Advanced + Car Cleaning Kit $299 Delivered @ Dyson Australia eBay
body:
Deal: [Box Damaged] Dyson V8 Advanced + Car Cleaning Kit $299 Delivered @ Dyson Australia eBay

[hotori] This or the Cyclone V8? I kind of want it for my shitty rental room carpeted floor mostly
[Boioioioi] Cyclone is a better more recent model, but its not compatible with the battery adapters to use power tool batteries. Attachments are also different.
So I got the advanced personally, battery adapters are important to me
[hotori] Yeah, I held off buying the cyclone in the last deal because of it but I'm wondering if I should wait for a new deal or get this one.
How much more powerful is the cyclone over this?
[Pcoder] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/924968
115 vs 150 air watts and 40 minutes of battery vs 60.
As this is a new product, they might not have the swappable barries yet but it doesn't mean there wont ever be a 3rd party option.
[hotori] @Pcoder: Wow thanks for sharing. Didn't know such a useful comparison table existed.
Guess I'll hold on for the cyclone and hope the battery doesn't die that fast
[caprimulgus] Attachments are also different.
Do you mean it includes a different set of attachments? Or the attachments are not compatible?
My understanding was that the batteries were incompatible, but the attachments were compatible (between V8 Cyclone and older V8).
[Boioioioi] Includes different set. I am not sure about compatibility
[caprimulgus] @Boioioioi: Ah cool, that makes sense then.
Yep, to my understanding they are all cross-compatible between all the V8 models, including Cyclone. (I was looking because I was planning to get the V8 Car & Boat and V8 Cyclone, and wanting them to be cross-compatible in attachments).
[Kramo] I'm a trigger fan. I don't want the toggle button on a cordless stick vacuum
[mathemagician] Need to replace my failing V8, but tempted to wait for another V15 or Gen5 deal for the stronger suction. Missed the last couple of deals.
I only have a 1BR apartment with lots of carpet and want to replace my V8 and big vacuum with one device.
[drezy] holding out for a better deal on the V15 + dok currently $799 box damaged
[Starlight8] May i ask how this compares to the V10 Animal and/or V10 itself?
Thanks
[xuqi] Dyson & Sony must employ a team of dedicated box vandals.
